# OneSolve Studio

> Independent iOS studio making focused, local-first apps. One app, one problem. No ads, no accounts, no tracking.

OneSolve apps keep working data on the device. Prices are in USD and vary by App Store region. Contact: onesolve@foxmail.com

## Apps

- [RockSort: Six Priorities Daily](https://wodedaima261103.github.io/onesolve/rocksort/): Plan six daily priorities with the Ivy Lee method and Eisenhower Matrix. Offline, no account, no ads.
- [Seeora](https://wodedaima261103.github.io/onesolve/seeora/): A quiet habit tracker for daily routines, streaks, backfill and rest days — no guilt, no ads, no account.
- [US Paycheck](https://wodedaima261103.github.io/onesolve/us-paycheck/): Estimate take-home pay for all 50 states with federal, state, FICA, Medicare and local city tax — on-device.
- [Jotlet](https://wodedaima261103.github.io/onesolve/jotlet/): Capture text, voice and photos in seconds. On-device notes with no folders, no streaks and no account.
- [Echora](https://wodedaima261103.github.io/onesolve/echora/): A local-first memory keeper: write once, and it returns on the day you chose, with its own arrival ritual.

## Pages

- [About](https://wodedaima261103.github.io/onesolve/about/): OneSolve Studio background and principles.
- [Contact](https://wodedaima261103.github.io/onesolve/contact/): support, press, directory and creator enquiries.
- [Media Kit](https://wodedaima261103.github.io/onesolve/media-kit/): 512px icons, screenshots and press copy for every app.
- [Privacy Policy](https://wodedaima261103.github.io/onesolve/privacy-policy/): local storage, optional Echora iCloud backup, RevenueCat purchase status and deletion steps.
- [Support & FAQ](https://wodedaima261103.github.io/onesolve/support/): per-app purchase, data and troubleshooting answers.
- [Terms of Use](https://wodedaima261103.github.io/onesolve/terms/): licence, purchases, refunds and estimates disclaimer.
